question: Average total catch per trip by county in Kenya?

claims.text: Average total catch kg per trip by gaul_1_name for kenya_validated_trips (top: Lamu = 71.98; 5 groups). Every figure below is computed from rows.

citations.sql:
WITH grain AS (
  SELECT trip_id AS trip_id, ANY_VALUE(gaul_1_name) AS gaul_1_name, ANY_VALUE(tot_catch_kg) AS tot_catch_kg
  FROM read_csv_auto('/Users/lore/Desktop/work/wf_projects/WDB/peskas/kenya_validated_trips.csv')
  GROUP BY trip_id
)
SELECT gaul_1_name, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(tot_catch_kg), 2) AS avg_total_catch_kg_per_trip
FROM grain
WHERE gaul_1_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY gaul_1_name
ORDER BY avg_total_catch_kg_per_trip DESC
